title: The Docks
text:
You've made it to the Docks! 

Either hire, sneak, or fight your way onto a boat!

Be wary, Lucien Voss is not well liked by the mariners at the dock, as he has put many of their compatriots behind bars.
dmNotes:
# Who's in this scene

- Lucien Voss - He will get the party's attention before they choose what to do
- Mariners - each group of mariners hate's Lucien, as he has put many of their fellow mariners behind bars, justly so

# What you need to do

Tell the party they can either try to 

- hire a boat, if you decide they found money or loot they may have enough to hire a boat to the island
- sneak onto a boat, they can buy clothes to look like mariners from the merchant, or they can simply distract a group of mariners and steal their boat
- fight for a boat - if they begin combat, the entire docks will fight them, and Lucien will join in as well

Whether or not Lucien makes it to the boat, he will find his own way to the island and meet the party there
